objective: Check whether an inverter-based resource event trace remains connected inside a voltage/time ride-through envelope and provides required reactive current support during a voltage sag.

submission_schema.declared_compliant: Boolean compliance declaration for the supplied event trace.

hard_constraints: The resource must not disconnect while the voltage/time point remains inside the ride-through envelope.
Reactive current iq_pu must meet the minimum support requirement after response_deadline_s while voltage is below voltage_below_pu.
The submission must declare compliance only when all clause-level checks pass.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether ride-through and reactive-current support constraints pass.

metrics.name: ride_through_pass
metrics.description: Whether the trace remains connected inside the ride-through envelope.

metrics.name: reactive_current_pass
metrics.description: Whether reactive current support meets the minimum after the deadline.

metrics.name: min_voltage_pu
metrics.description: Minimum voltage observed in the event trace.
